latencies.notes: Slope method (--unroll 100000, --unroll2 200000), median of three runs; 0 cycles of flag-helper latency subtracted where the chain closes through x86mtflag/x86mfflag. Measured on 2026-11-17 on LA464, core 0.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: setx86loopne $r12, $r4; setx86loopne $r13, $r5; setx86loopne $r14, $r6; setx86loopne $r15, $r7; setx86loopne $r16, $r8; setx86loopne $r17, $r9; setx86loopne $r18, $r10; setx86loopne $r19, $r11
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; x86mtflag $r0, 0
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; x86mtflag $r0, 0' --asm 'setx86loopne $r12, $r4; setx86loopne $r13, $r5; setx86loopne $r14, $r6; setx86loopne $r15, $r7; setx86loopne $r16, $r8; setx86loopne $r17, $r9; setx86loopne $r18, $r10; setx86loopne $r19, $r11'
